children: Made Fresh Salads is recalling all ready to eat deli-style salads and cream cheese due to the risk of listeria.

The products were distributed in New York City under the Made Fresh Salads and Northside brands. The recalled items include black bean and corn salad, bruschetta, chickpea salad, potato salad and several others.

No illnesses have been reported to date., Made Fresh said. The recall was the result of environmental sampling by the Food and Drug Administration and the company, which revealed that some areas of its facility tested positive for listeria, it added.
Made Fresh Salads recalled multiple cream-cheese items in February.
